subject.title: [Feature]: Slack Block Kit support for agent messages

question: Should OpenClaw bless a Slack-native Block Kit producer/report path, or keep portable `presentation` as the only supported rich-output API while deferring richer report/table/rich_text layouts to a future schema?
rationale: Current code can send raw Slack blocks and render portable presentations, but documenting provider-native report/table payloads would create a channel-specific producer contract rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep This Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Slack-native producer boundary, then close it only after the chosen path is documented or split into a narrower live issue.

options.title: Bless Slack-Native Blocks
options.body: Document a trusted-producer Slack Block Kit path with fallback text, validation limits, examples, and live Slack proof before implementation PRs proceed.

options.title: Portable Presentation Only
options.body: Document raw Slack blocks as compatibility-only and track metric fields, table layouts, and rich_text conversion as future portable presentation schema work.

recommendation.title: Keep This Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Slack-native producer boundary, then close it only after the chosen path is documented or split into a narrower live issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the live assignee and authored several merged Slack Block Kit slices adjacent to the remaining decision.
